The '''Ord Gimmel Defense Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that defended [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. It made use of [[Darvro-class light freighter|''Darvro''-class light freighters]] and [[Tallanx-class stealth fighter|''Tallanx''-class stealth fighters]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
